title: SwiftSecuencia Timeline Definition
description: JSON schema for defining video timelines that SwiftSecuencia can convert to Final Cut Pro FCPXML format

clips.description: Array of clips, markers, and media elements that make up the timeline

TimelineConfig.description: Timeline configuration including format and audio settings

name.description: Name of the timeline. REQUIRED — a missing or empty name causes a JSON decode failure. This value appears in Final Cut Pro as both the event name and the project name.

frameRate.description: Video frame rate as a string

colorSpace.description: Color space for the video. Defaults to rec709 if omitted. HDR options: rec2020hlg (Hybrid Log-Gamma), rec2020pq (Dolby Vision / HDR10). Maps to FCPXML colorSpace values: rec709→"1-1-1 (Rec. 709)", rec2020→"9-18-9 (Rec. 2020)", etc.

rate.description: Audio sample rate. Accepted forms: kHz-suffixed string ("44.1kHz", "48kHz", "96kHz") or raw Hz integer string ("44100", "48000", "96000"). Both forms parse to the same AudioRate value. The FCPXML output always uses the raw Hz integer (e.g. audioRate="48000").

ClipDefinition.description: Definition of a single clip, marker, or media element

name.description: Name of the clip or marker

file.description: Path to the media file (relative to JSON file or absolute). Required for video, audio, and image clips.

offset.description: Start time of the clip on the timeline. Supports integer seconds (3s), decimal seconds (3.5s), or rational format (1001/24000s)

duration.description: Duration of the clip. Optional for audio/video - will be probed if omitted. Same format as offset.

lane.description: Timeline lane. 0 = primary storyline, positive = above (B-roll/titles), negative = below (audio/music)

markerType.description: Type of marker. Required when type is 'marker'
